<tool_call>

<parameter=code>
rows=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def pat(r0,r1,c0,c1):
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if rows[r][c]=='B']
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return tuple(''.join('X' if rows[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
def rots(m):
    out=[m]; cur=m
    for _ in range(3):
        cur=tuple(''.join(cur[len(cur)-1-c][r] for c in range(len(cur[0]))) for r in range(len(cur))); out.append(cur)
    return out
def eq(a,b):
    if len(a)!=len(b) or len(a[0])!=len(b[0]): return False
    return any(a==r for r in rots(b))

def yb(i): return pat(52,56,[7,17,22,29,36,43][i], [7,17,22,29,36,43][i]+5)
orig=yb(0)
print("yb1 orig:",orig,[k for k,v in Y.items() if eq(orig,v)])
action(['UP'])
new=yb(0)
print("yb1 after 1 UP:",new,[k for k,v in Y.items() if eq(new,v)],"blank?" , (new is None or all('.'==ch for row in new for ch in row)))

rows=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def pat(r0,r1,c0,c1):
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if rows[r][c]=='B']
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return tuple(''.join('X' if rows[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
def rots(m):
    out=[m]; cur=m
    for _ in range(3):
        cur=tuple(''.join(cur[len(cur)-1-c][r] for c in range(len(cur[0]))) for r in range(len(cur))); out.append(cur)
    return out
def eq(a,b):
    if len(a)!=len(b) or len(a[0])!=len(b[0]): return False
    return any(a==r for r in rots(b))
